engine.corrections.header:
# Fixes for words the computer hears wrong.
# One fix per line:  wrong = right
# Upper/lower case does not matter in "wrong". "wrong" must be at the end of a word, but may be the
# last part of a compound word (fløv also fixes tilmeldingsfløv). Lines starting with # are not used.
# The fixes are used the next time subtitles are made.
